questions.title: Count Numbers Greater Than 100
questions.question: Q4(a)
questions.task: Input 10 numbers. Count how many numbers are greater than 100. Output the count.
expectedThinking: Each number must be checked using IF
A counter variable stores how many numbers are greater than 100

markScheme.criterion: Correct IF condition and count increment

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE num, count, i : INTEGER

count <- 0

FOR i <- 1 TO 10
    INPUT num

    IF num > 100 THEN
        count <- count + 1
    ENDIF
NEXT i

OUTPUT count

questions.title: Output Numbers and Count Even Values
questions.question: Q4(b)
questions.task: Input a number N. Output all numbers from 1 to N. Also output how many of these numbers are even.
expectedThinking: N controls how many numbers are processed
A loop outputs values from 1 to N
IF checks whether each value is even
A counter tracks how many even values are found

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE N, i, evenCount : INTEGER

INPUT N

evenCount <- 0

FOR i <- 1 TO N
    OUTPUT i

    IF i MOD 2 = 0 THEN
        evenCount <- evenCount + 1
    ENDIF
NEXT i

OUTPUT evenCount
